study_note: Single-seed exploratory Humanoid Walk checkpoint bank for measuring post-hoc action-local improvement on an AMBI prior trained without an inner controller and with train_unroll_horizon=10. It is an exact scientific derivative of ambi_humanoid_walk_outer_prior_no_inner_checkpoint_bank_1p5m apart from the recurrent training unroll: the stochastic outer policy still collects every post-seed transition, inner_operator=none performs zero inner model steps and zero inner optimizer updates, outer_planning_horizon=3 and inner_rollout_horizon=3 remain fixed, and reference_weighted_mean with temporal_loss_reference_horizon=3 preserves the horizon-3 aggregate temporal-loss scale while redistributing it over ten learned-model transitions. The distributional five-head AMBI critic, entropy-augmented Bellman targets, and learned automatic outer temperature are unchanged. Separate evaluation episodes are disabled during training. Sixty portable checkpoints are retained at 25,000-decision intervals from 25,000 through 1,500,000, with no step-zero checkpoint. This isolates learned-prior sensitivity to a longer training unroll while keeping collection and later frozen-controller evaluation roles fixed; it remains a single-seed exploratory study.
